我们将 Windows 平台上 Unsloth Desktop 应用程序的 x64 版本和 ARM64 版本二进制文件合并为单个.exe 文件，这样在 RTX Spark 和 ARM64 机器上使用时就不会造成混淆了！

我们还支持 Winget 和 Mac Brew：
通过 Cask 方式安装 unsloth：brew install --cask unsloth
安装 Winget --id UnslothAI.Unsloth -e
 
https://
unsloth.ai/download

posts.text:
We made Inkling 2 Mini finetuning in Unsloth up to 3x faster and use 50% less VRAM!

Some optims:
> FlexAttention for SWA & sink attn
> Gradient checkpointing for looped layers - layers 6-17 run 3x forwards - their residuals are now recomputed
> Fused CE with final logit softcap
posts.quoted: You can now fine-tune Inkling 2 Mini with our free notebook! Local training works on 22GB VRAM. Unsloth trains Inkling 1.8-3.1x faster with 50% less VRAM vs. other setups. No accuracy loss Colab, Kaggle notebooks & Guide: https:// unsloth.ai/docs/models/in kling-2-mini/fine-tuning … GitHub: https:// github.com/unslothai/unsl oth …
